subject: Fix sanitizer builds with clang (#1402)
reason: The change only moves the #include <stdatomic.h> line in src/unit/test_networking.c (a unit-test source file) so the file compiles under clang sanitizer builds. It is a build fix for test code with no change to server behaviour, commands, replication, persistence or tools, so no fuzzer scenario can exercise it and none is needed.
